summary: The LIVE student-management page for school_admin is account-students -> SAStudents.js (a self-contained drawer-based CRUD UI). It is wired end-to-end and mostly solid: every button (Add, Edit, Toggle active, Block/Unblock, Delete-with-confirm, Search, 7 drawer tabs, photo upload, Copy credentials) maps to a real handler and a real backend endpoint under the bare /api/students/* routes (mounted via routes/superadmin.js lines 263-274). Those routes ARE role-gated (sla = [requireActiveAccount, requireRole(['superadmin','school_admin'])]) and the controller (superadminDataController.js) tenant-scopes every operation via scopedSchoolId(req): a school_admin is pinned to their own school on list/create and gets a 404 on cross-tenant id access (update/delete/toggle/block). The bare-list superadmin PII leak that memory flagged is closed (getSuperStudents returns empty unless ?school_id is supplied). Client-supplied school_id is ignored for school_admin (forced to token school_id), and vaccinations JSON is sanitized. So the core flow is functional and tenant-isolated. The real issues are: (1) the plain 'students' permission key is an orphan that renders the generic 'under development' StubPage; (2) ALL student create/update/delete actions write NO audit log despite the system having appendSecurityAuditLog wired everywhere else (account + password resets happen untracked); (3) every parent account created alongside a student is given the predictable default password 'Parent@123' (the form has no parent-password field) and that default is then displayed in the 'Save Credentials' panel as if it were a real generated secret; (4) the fetch helpers throw bare 'HTTP 4xx/5xx' and never read the backend's error message, so meaningful server validation/permission messages ('No school is linked to your account', 'School not found') are replaced with codes; (5) the mobile (<=600px) card-layout CSS relies on data-label attributes the table rows never set, so on phones the table cells render right-aligned with no column labels.
workingWell: account-students -> SAStudents.js is fully wired end-to-end: openCreate/openEdit/handleSubmit/handleToggle/handleBlock/handleDelete all hit live endpoints that exist and execute (superadminDataController.js getSuperStudents/createSuperStudent/updateSuperStudent/deleteSuperStudent/toggleSuperStudentStatus/blockSuperStudent).

Tenant isolation is correctly enforced server-side: scopedSchoolId(req) (controller lines 55-60) forces a school_admin to their own school_id, ignores any client-sent school_id on create (line 3025), and outsideScope() returns 404 on cross-tenant id access for update/delete/toggle/block (lines 3143/3180/3192/3203). The memory-noted bare-list PII leak is closed: getSuperStudents returns an empty list for a superadmin unless ?school_id is provided (lines 2950-2952).

Routes are role-gated: the bare /api/students/* CRUD is behind sla = [requireActiveAccount, requireRole(['superadmin','school_admin'])] (superadmin.js line 227), and a suspended/rejected school_admin is blocked per-request even with a valid token.

Input hardening present: vaccinations JSON is bounded/sanitized via sanitizeVaccinations (controller lines 70-86); delete runs in a DB transaction removing both Student and the linked User (lines 3175-3186).

Frontend has proper loading, error-banner, and empty states (lines 873-888), Escape-to-close on the drawer, required-field validation before submit, and a delete confirmation inline step. Response shape matches: successResponse spreads keys to top level so d.students/d.username/d.password/d.parents resolve correctly.
Mobile rules exist for the form: SAStudents.css collapses grids to one column and full-width drawer at <=600px, and icon buttons are 44px touch targets at <=600px (SARefDataManager.css line 1801).

findings.title: Plain 'students' permission key renders the generic 'under development' stub
findings.evidence: permissions.js grants school_admin the 'students' key, but SuperadminDashboard.js HANDLED_PAGES (lines 366-389) does NOT contain 'students' and there is no `activePage === 'students'` render block; it falls through to <StubPage title=... "This section is under development."/> (~line 1508). The real page is 'account-students' -> SAStudents. 'students' has no nav row in SCHOOL_ADMIN_NAV_ITEMS, so it is only reachable by manually setting activePage / global search.
findings.userImpact: If a school admin reaches the 'students' key (e.g. via global search or a stale deep link), they see a meaningless 'under development' placeholder even though full student management exists under account-students.
findings.suggestedFix: Either redirect/alias the 'students' key to render SAStudents (same as account-students), or remove 'students' from school_admin permissions so it can never resolve to a dead stub.
findings.backendTrace: No backend involved; purely a frontend routing/permissions orphan.

findings.title: Student create/update/delete and password resets write no audit log
findings.evidence: appendSecurityAuditLog is imported (line 39) and used in ~18 other handlers (settings/security/governance, e.g. lines 219,387,552,907...), but createSuperStudent (3019-3137), updateSuperStudent (3139-3173, which resets the student's password via bcrypt at line 3150), deleteSuperStudent (3175-3186, which destroys the Student AND the User), toggleSuperStudentStatus, and blockSuperStudent write NO audit entry.
findings.userImpact: Creating a student+parent accounts, resetting a student's login password, blocking, or permanently deleting a student and their user record leaves no trace. There is no way to see who deleted a student or reset credentials — a real concern for a multi-tenant system holding minors' medical/SEN/disciplinary PII.
findings.suggestedFix: Call appendSecurityAuditLog in createSuperStudent/updateSuperStudent/deleteSuperStudent/toggle/block with actor (req.user), action, student id, and school_id, mirroring the existing audited handlers.
findings.backendTrace: Endpoints exist and execute correctly; they simply omit the audit-write step that the rest of the controller performs.

findings.title: Auto-created parent accounts get predictable 'Parent@123' and it is displayed as a real credential
findings.evidence: The Add-Student form (parents tab, SAStudents.js lines 645-701) collects father/mother name/phone/email but has NO parent password field, and handleSubmit never sends father_password/mother_password. createSuperStudent registerParent() defaults `const pw = p.password || 'Parent@123'` (line 3091) and returns that pw as the parent credential. The success panel then renders it verbatim as 'Password' for each parent (SAStudents.js lines 1010-1013). The student account has the same issue: studentPw defaults to 'Student@123' (line 3032) when the admin leaves the password blank.
findings.userImpact: Every parent (and every blank-password student) is provisioned with the same publicly-guessable password across the whole platform. The UI presents it in the 'Save Credentials' box as if it were a unique generated secret, so admins distribute a known-default password believing it is safe. An attacker who knows the username pattern can log into parent accounts.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate a random strong password server-side when none is supplied (for both student and parents) instead of a hardcoded constant, and/or force a password change on first parent/student login. Optionally expose a parent-password field in the form.
findings.backendTrace: POST /api/students/ -> createSuperStudent: hardcoded defaults at lines 3032 (student) and 3091 (parents).

findings.title: Fetch helpers throw bare 'HTTP 4xx/5xx' and discard the server's error message
findings.evidence: apiGet/apiPatch/apiDelete/apiMultipart all do `if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status)` (lines 24,35,44,54) without reading the JSON body. The backend returns useful messages on 4xx — e.g. createSuperStudent 'No school is linked to your account' (403, line 3024), 'School not found' (400, line 3028), and cross-tenant denials. On any non-2xx these surface to the user as 'HTTP 400' / 'HTTP 403' / 'HTTP 500' in saveErr/actionErr instead of the real reason.
findings.userImpact: When a save, delete, toggle, or block fails for a real reason, the school admin sees an opaque 'HTTP 403' / 'HTTP 500' with no actionable explanation. Only the success-but-failed (200 with success:false) path shows a real message; genuine HTTP error statuses do not.
findings.suggestedFix: In each helper, on !res.ok try `const body = await res.json(); throw new Error(body.message || ('HTTP ' + res.status))` so backend messages reach the banners.
findings.backendTrace: Backend correctly returns status + message; the frontend helper drops the body.

findings.title: Mobile card layout shows no column labels because rows lack data-label attributes
findings.evidence: At <=600px the shared table CSS hides the header and switches each row to a stacked card where each cell prints its label via `content: attr(data-label)` (SARefDataManager.css lines 1763-1789). But SAStudents.js renders the cells as plain `<span className="sard-td">` with NO data-label attribute (NAME/ADMISSION NO/STATUS/SCHOOL/ADDED, lines 901-918). There are also two competing @media(max-width:600px) .sard-tr blocks (line 1038 keeps a grid; line 1766 forces block layout) in the same stylesheet.
findings.userImpact: On a phone the student list becomes a stack of right-aligned values (name, admission number, status, date) with blank/empty label chips, so it is unclear which value is which. The project mandates mobile responsiveness on every component; this row is effectively unlabeled on small screens.
findings.suggestedFix: Add data-label="Name"/"Admission No"/"Status"/"School"/"Added" to the corresponding .sard-td spans in SAStudents.js (matching how SARefDataManager rows are built), and reconcile the duplicate <=600px .sard-tr rules so only the card layout applies.
findings.backendTrace: No backend involvement.

findings.title: Live student page has no Resend Credentials action (button + endpoint exist elsewhere but unused here)
findings.evidence: ResendCredentialsButton (src/components/schooladmin/ResendCredentialsButton.js) and adminApi.resendCredentials exist, but SAStudents.js never imports them — the only row actions are Edit/Toggle/Block/Delete (lines 934-960). A school admin cannot re-issue a student's or parent's login from the student page; the only way to change a password is the Edit drawer (and even then the new password is not shown).
findings.userImpact: If a parent or student loses their (default 'Parent@123'/'Student@123') password, the admin has no in-page way to regenerate and re-send it from account-students; they must edit the record and manually re-distribute.
findings.suggestedFix: Add ResendCredentialsButton (or an equivalent reset action) to each student row using s.user_id, once a working resend endpoint exists.
findings.backendTrace: Note: ResendCredentialsButton -> adminApi.resendCredentials POSTs to /api/school/users/resend-credentials/, which does NOT exist in routes/school.js (grep for 'resend' in routes/ returns only auth resend-otp). That missing endpoint primarily affects the teachers/finance-users forms that DO render the button; on account-students the feature is simply absent.

findings.title: Admission number is free-text with no auto-suggest despite a backend next-admission-number endpoint
findings.evidence: The Academic tab renders Admission Number as a plain text input (line 591) and createSuperStudent stores it as-is with no uniqueness check (controller line 3045). The backend exposes GET /api/school/students/next-admission-number/ (routes/school.js line 169) which SAStudents never calls.
findings.userImpact: Admins type admission numbers by hand with no suggestion and no duplicate guard, so two students can be given the same (or inconsistently formatted) admission number within a school.
findings.suggestedFix: On openCreate, call the existing next-admission-number endpoint to prefill the field, and/or add a server-side uniqueness check per school on create.
findings.backendTrace: GET /api/school/students/next-admission-number/ exists (school.js line 169) but is unused by this UI; create path performs no uniqueness validation.

unit: teachers (pages: account-teachers [live] + teachers [stub]); component src/components/superadmin/SATeachers.js, dead module src/components/schooladmin/Teachers/** + NewPages.TeachersPage
summary: The LIVE school_admin teacher experience is SATeachers.js (nav key account-teachers, SuperadminDashboard line 1489), backed by the bare /api/teachers/ endpoints on the superadmin router. End-to-end CRUD (create/edit/toggle/block/delete) is fully functional and the backend is properly tenant-isolated: router.use(authenticateToken)+schoolScope (superadmin.js:95-96), sla=[requireActiveAccount, requireRole(['superadmin','school_admin'])] on every /teachers/ route (superadmin.js:289-294), and controllers pin school_id from JWT via scopedSchoolId() on create and reject cross-tenant rows with outsideScope()->404 on update/delete/toggle/block. No IDOR, no client-trusted school_id. Responsiveness is handled (SAStaffManager.css has @media max-width:600px and an overflow-x:auto table wrap with min-width:720px). The real problems are: (1) an entire polished teacher module — schooladmin/Teachers/** wizard (AddTeacherWizard, BulkImportModal, PreviewPanel, WelcomeLetter, SendCredentials, ClassAssignmentEditor, AvailabilityGrid, ComplianceStep) plus NewPages.TeachersPage with server-side search, teacher-stats cards, overload filter and profile panels backed by /api/school/teachers/ — is built and imported but NEVER rendered for any role (dead code); school_admin instead gets the simpler SATeachers; (2) SATeachers search/status filtering is client-side over only the current 20-row page even though the backend getSuperTeachers supports q= and status= params, so searching for a teacher who is on a later page returns a false 'No results'; (3) every teacher is created with the shared default password Teacher@123 and must_change_password stays false (never sent), so there is no forced first-login rotation; (4) the plain 'teachers' permission key renders the generic 'under development' StubPage.
workingWell: Tenant isolation on the live path is correct: every /api/teachers/ route carries authenticateToken + schoolScope (superadmin.js:95-96) and sla=[requireActiveAccount, requireRole(['superadmin','school_admin'])] (superadmin.js:227,289-294); a school_admin's school_id is pinned from JWT via scopedSchoolId() and cannot be overridden by the client.

Writes are tenant-pinned: createSuperTeacher forces data.school_id = forcedSchool (superadminDataController.js:3557); update/delete/toggle/block all call outsideScope(scopedSchoolId(req), teacher.school_id) and return 404 for cross-tenant rows (3613, 3645, 3656, 3667) — no IDOR.

All five table actions are wired end-to-end to existing, implemented endpoints: Add/Edit -> POST/PUT /api/teachers/, Activate/Deactivate -> PATCH /toggle/, Block/Unblock -> PATCH /block/, Delete -> DELETE (with a confirm modal). Delete also removes the linked User (superadminDataController.js:3646-3647), so login access is revoked.

Create returns the real generated username and password and surfaces them in a one-time copy-to-clipboard credentials modal (SATeachers.js:189-194, 345-361); edit correctly omits the password (form useEffect skips it, line 391) and only changes it if a new one is typed (controller 3620).

Loading, empty, and error states are all present: spinner while loading (line 251), distinct empty messages for no-teachers vs no-search-results (254-258), and toast on API error (144). Pagination uses the server total (218, 322-330).

Responsiveness is handled: SAStaffManager.css has @media(max-width:600px) (lines 344-355) stacking head/search/filters/form/modal and giving 42-46px touch targets, plus a .sasm-table-wrap overflow-x:auto with .sasm-table min-width:720px (110-116) so the wide table scrolls on mobile rather than overflowing.

findings.title: Entire polished teacher-management module (Teachers/ wizard + NewPages.TeachersPage) is built, imported, but never rendered for school_admin
findings.evidence: NewPages.js:4342 `export function TeachersPage({ school })` is a full card-grid teacher UI: server-side debounced search via /api/school/teachers/?q= (line 4356-4368), stats cards via /api/school/teacher-stats/ (4370-4373), overloaded filter, TeacherProfilePanel (4526), AddTeacherWizard (4536, imported NewPages.js:7), BulkImportModal (4545, imported line 8), EditTeacherModal (4554). The Teachers/ dir holds AddTeacherWizard.jsx, BulkImportModal.jsx, PreviewPanel.jsx, WelcomeLetter.jsx, SendCredentials.jsx, ClassAssignmentEditor.jsx, AvailabilityGrid.jsx, ComplianceStep.jsx, etc. But `grep -rn TeachersPage src` returns ONLY its own definition — it is exported and never imported. SuperadminDashboard.js:1489 renders `<SATeachers />` for account-teachers, not NewPages.TeachersPage. _deprecated/README.md:35 even claims Teachers/ is 'imported by the live NewPages.js; keep' — true that NewPages imports it, but NewPages.TeachersPage itself is dead.
findings.userImpact: A school admin never sees the richer teacher workflow (server-side search across all pages, teacher stats, class-load/overload view, profile panels, bulk CSV import, welcome-letter + send-credentials onboarding). They get the simpler SATeachers table instead. Significant built functionality is invisible to users and the corresponding backend (/api/school/teachers/, /api/school/teacher-stats/, bulk import) is reachable but UI-orphaned.
findings.suggestedFix: Decide on ONE teacher page. Either (a) route account-teachers to NewPages.TeachersPage (verify /api/school/teachers/ tenant-gating first — it uses school.js applyAuth, separate from the well-scoped /api/teachers/ path) and retire SATeachers, or (b) delete schooladmin/Teachers/**, NewPages.TeachersPage, and the related imports as confirmed dead code to stop shipping ~20 unused .jsx files in the bundle.
findings.backendTrace: Dead UI would call /api/school/teachers/ (GET/POST/PUT exist: school.js:174-176) and /api/school/teacher-stats/ (school.js:177). These endpoints exist but are only reachable from this orphaned component.

findings.title: Teacher search and status filter only match the current 20-row page; teachers on other pages show false 'No results'
findings.evidence: load() builds params with only page & limit: `new URLSearchParams({ page, limit: LIMIT })` and never appends q or status (SATeachers.js:140-141, LIMIT=20 line 18). The `visible` useMemo (163-173) filters `list` (the current page's 20 rows) client-side by search text and statusF. So when total>20, typing a name that lives on page 2+ yields the empty state 'No results for the current search / filter.' (line 257) even though the teacher exists. The backend getSuperTeachers explicitly supports server-side q (superadminDataController.js:3497-3503) and status (3496) — the frontend just doesn't use them.
findings.userImpact: A school admin with more than 20 teachers searches for a colleague, gets 'No results', and reasonably concludes the teacher isn't registered — leading to duplicate registrations or wasted time. The Active/Inactive/Blocked filter is similarly limited to the visible page.
findings.suggestedFix: Send search and status to the server: include `q` (debounced) and `status` in load()'s URLSearchParams and let the backend filter+paginate; reset page to 1 on query/filter change. Keep the client-side `visible` filter only as a cosmetic layer over server-filtered results, or remove it.
findings.backendTrace: /api/teachers/ GET -> getSuperTeachers (superadminDataController.js:3483) already accepts q and status and paginates with findAndCountAll; no backend change needed.

findings.title: Teachers created with shared default password Teacher@123 and are never forced to change it
findings.evidence: DEFAULT_PW='Teacher@123' (SATeachers.js:17). If the admin leaves Password blank, createSuperTeacher uses `data.password || 'Teacher@123'` (superadminDataController.js:3560). The form's SECTIONS has no must_change_password field, so it is never sent; backend sets `must_change_password: data.must_change_password` (3599) = undefined, falling to the Teacher model default `false` (src/models/Teacher.js:51). The creds modal tells the admin to 'share them securely' (SATeachers.js:350) but nothing forces the teacher to rotate the shared password on first login.
findings.userImpact: Many teachers across the tenant share the identical, well-known password Teacher@123 and are never prompted to change it. Anyone who knows the convention can guess credentials; a teacher who never changes it leaves an account permanently on the default password.
findings.suggestedFix: Set must_change_password=true by default when a teacher is created without an explicit password (in createSuperTeacher, or force it from the frontend), and enforce a change-password gate on first teacher login. Consider generating a random temp password instead of a fixed constant.
findings.backendTrace: /api/teachers/ POST -> createSuperTeacher (superadminDataController.js:3550-3606); model default must_change_password=false (Teacher.js:51). No first-login rotation gate observed for this flow.

findings.title: Permission key 'teachers' renders the generic 'under development' stub (orphan permission)
findings.evidence: school_admin is granted the 'teachers' key in permissions.js (per shared inventory line 57) but there is no `activePage === 'teachers'` render block, it is not in HANDLED_PAGES, and it is not in SCHOOL_ADMIN_NAV_ITEMS — so it falls through to <StubPage title='Teachers' 'This section is under development.'> (SuperadminDashboard.js StubPage fallback ~1508). The functional page lives under the separate key account-teachers (line 1489 -> SATeachers).
findings.userImpact: Not reachable from the sidebar, so most admins never hit it; but any deep link / global-search hit on the 'teachers' key shows a misleading 'under development' page for a feature that is actually fully built under account-teachers.
findings.suggestedFix: Either remove the orphan 'teachers' permission for school_admin, or alias activePage 'teachers' to render SATeachers so a direct hit doesn't show a false stub.
findings.backendTrace: N/A — pure frontend routing; no endpoint involved.

findings.title: createSuperTeacher does not validate employee_id (or username) uniqueness within a school
findings.evidence: createSuperTeacher (superadminDataController.js:3550-3606) requires first_name/last_name/employee_id (3553-3554) but performs no existence check before Teacher.create; two teachers in the same school can be created with the same employee_id. Username collisions are sidestepped by appending `_${Date.now()}` (3559) but employee_id is stored verbatim (3573).
findings.userImpact: A school admin can accidentally register the same employee_id twice (e.g. re-submitting after the search bug above hides an existing teacher), producing duplicate teacher records that later collide in payroll/exam-officer/assignment views.
findings.suggestedFix: Before create, check for an existing Teacher with the same employee_id under the scoped school_id and return a 409 with a clear message; ideally add a composite unique index (school_id, employee_id) at the DB level.
findings.backendTrace: /api/teachers/ POST -> createSuperTeacher; no pre-insert uniqueness query observed.

summary: The live School-Admin "parents" experience is a single component, src/components/superadmin/SAParents.js, mounted at activePage 'account-parents'. The schooladmin/Parents/** directory referenced in the brief DOES NOT EXIST (no dead component to compare). The slice is largely solid end-to-end: every button (Add, Edit, Toggle, Block, Delete, Link, search, status filters, pagination, copy-credentials) is wired to a real handler hitting an endpoint that exists, is role-gated (requireRole(['superadmin','school_admin']) via the `sla` chain), tenant-scoped (parentInSchool/scopedSchoolId), and active-account-gated (requireActiveAccount). The prior audit's "wrong password shown" claim is FIXED — verified: the creds modal shows form.password or the DEFAULT_PW 'Parent@123' which matches the backend default exactly, so the displayed password is always the real one. Responsiveness is good (table-wrap overflow-x scroll, min-width fallback, full @media(max-width:600px) block, 42-46px touch targets). The one real functional defect: the create-parent form has NO student-linking field and never sends student_ids, but getSuperParents for a school_admin only returns parents linked to that school's students — so a freshly created (unlinked) parent immediately disappears from the list, and because the "Link to student" action is a per-row button, the admin can never reach it. That is a genuine dead-end. Secondary: the Link modal's student picker loads only the first 100 students with no pagination/search and no truncation indicator.
workingWell: Add/Edit/Toggle/Block/Delete/Link parent flows all hit existing endpoints: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/parents/, PATCH /api/parents/:id/toggle/ and /block/, POST /api/link-parent/ — every route exists in backend_node/src/routes/superadmin.js (lines 277-286) and maps to implemented controllers in superadminDataController.js (3211-3400), none are stubs/no-ops.

Tenant isolation is enforced server-side: getSuperParents (3211) derives the school from scopedSchoolId(req) and filters parents to those linked to the caller's own students; update/delete/toggle/block all call parentInSchool(parent.id, forcedSchool) before mutating (3320/3347/3363/3377); link-parent re-checks the student's school via outsideScope (3392). Client-supplied IDs are never trusted blindly.

Auth/role gating: the parent routes sit behind authenticateToken + schoolScope + requireActiveAccount + requireRole(['superadmin','school_admin']); no TODO_JWT_TOKEN backdoor on this router (that issue was on /api/school/*, not these /api/parents/ routes).

Credentials modal password is correct (prior 'wrong password' bug is resolved): SAParents.js:134 password = d.password || form.password || DEFAULT_PW, DEFAULT_PW='Parent@123' equals backend default at superadminDataController.js:3282, so the shown password always matches what was stored.

Responsiveness compliant: SAStaffManager.css table-wrap uses overflow-x:auto with min-width:720px (lines 110-116), and a full @media(max-width:600px) block (344-355) stacks the header/filters/form/modal and sets 42-46px touch targets.

Good UX states: loading spinner, distinct empty states for no-parents vs no-search-results (SAParents.js:201-206), error toasts on every catch, one-time copyable credentials modal, delete confirm modal with consequences spelled out.

findings.title: Newly created parent disappears from the School-Admin list because create has no student-link and the list only shows parents linked to the school's students
findings.evidence: The create form SECTIONS (SAParents.js:46-66) only contains Account + Profile fields — there is NO student-link field — and handleSave (117-139) builds a FormData of just those fields plus passport_photo; it never sends student_ids. Backend getSuperParents (superadminDataController.js:3224-3231) builds where.id from StudentParent links to the caller's own students only: it queries the school's students, then `where.id = [...new Set(links.map(l => l.parent_id))]`. A parent with zero links yields an empty IN (...) set and is excluded. So after the success/credentials modal, load() refetches and the new parent is NOT in the returned list. The only way to link is the per-row IcLink button (SAParents.js:257) which requires the parent to already be visible in the table.
findings.userImpact: A school admin clicks Add Parent, fills the form, sees the 'Parent account created' credentials modal, then the parent is nowhere in the list. They cannot click Link-to-student (no row exists), cannot edit, cannot delete it — the account is orphaned and invisible. Re-adding creates duplicate User/Parent rows. It looks like creation silently failed.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a student multi-select (reusing the same GET /api/students/ picker already in LinkModal) to the create form and pass student_ids to POST /api/parents/ — the backend createSuperParent already accepts and validates data.student_ids (superadminDataController.js:3275-3306). Alternatively, after a successful create, immediately open the Link modal for the new parent, or relax getSuperParents to also include parents created by/visible to the school until linked. The student-link path on create is the cleanest since the controller already supports it.
findings.backendTrace: POST /api/parents/ → superadmin.js:278 → createSuperParent (superadminDataController.js:3268) EXISTS, role+tenant gated, supports student_ids but UI never sends them. GET /api/parents/ → superadmin.js:277 → getSuperParents (3211) filters strictly by StudentParent links (3224-3231), excluding unlinked parents.

findings.title: Link-to-student picker loads only the first 100 students with no pagination, search, or truncation notice
findings.evidence: LinkModal fetches GET /api/students/ with no query params (SAParents.js:426) and renders every returned student as a <select> option (446-454). Backend getSuperStudents (superadminDataController.js:2945) defaults limit=100 and paginates via findAndCountAll (2964-2967). The frontend only falls back to a raw numeric ID input when students.length === 0 (455-457) — never when the list is merely truncated.
findings.userImpact: In a school with more than 100 students, parents can only be linked to students who happen to be in the first 100 (ordered by id DESC, i.e. newest). Older students are silently unselectable and there is no search box or 'showing 100 of N' hint, so the admin assumes the student doesn't exist.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the LinkModal picker searchable/server-filtered: pass ?q= to /api/students/ as the admin types (getSuperStudents already supports a `q` filter, superadminDataController.js:2957-2963) and/or request a higher limit, and always keep the raw-ID input available as a fallback rather than only when the list is empty.

findings.title: Credentials modal default password is hardcoded and silently coupled to the backend default
findings.evidence: SAParents.js:17 DEFAULT_PW = 'Parent@123' and line 134 falls back to it when the admin leaves the password blank and the API omits the password. The backend independently hardcodes the same value in createSuperParent (superadminDataController.js:3282 `data.password || 'Parent@123'`). The two constants must stay byte-identical or the modal would display a password that does not match the stored hash.
findings.userImpact: Correct today (both equal 'Parent@123'), so the admin sees the real password. But it is a latent footgun: if a backend dev changes the default password policy without updating the frontend constant, the modal would show a wrong password and parents would be locked out, with no error surfaced. The create endpoint should return the generated password instead of relying on a duplicated literal.
findings.suggestedFix: Have createSuperParent return the actually-applied password (or a clear 'password set by admin' flag) in its success payload so the frontend can display d.password authoritatively, and drop the duplicated DEFAULT_PW literal. This mirrors how username is already returned and consumed (d.username).

findings.title: Search and status filter only cover the current pagination page; backend q-search is unused
findings.evidence: load() fetches one server page with limit=20 and only ?page/limit params (SAStaffManager.js 150-152) - it never sends a search/q param. The `visible` memo filters `list` (the 20 loaded rows) client-side for both search text and status (lines 174-184). The backend getSuperPrincipals fully supports a `q` param (superadminDataController.js 3848-3854, matches first/last name, email, username, employee_id) and a `status` param (3847), neither of which the UI uses.
findings.userImpact: A school admin with more than 20 principals (rare but possible for large institutions, and the same SAStaffManager powers the bursar page where it is more likely) who searches for a person on page 2+ gets 'No results for the current search / filter' even though the record exists. The status filter chips (Active/Inactive/Blocked) likewise only reflect the current page, so counts/filtering are misleading once paginated.
findings.suggestedFix: Send search and status to the server: pass the debounced search term as ?q= and the active status chip as ?status= into load()'s URLSearchParams, and reset to page 1 on filter change. Then the existing client-side `visible` filter becomes a thin no-op or can be removed. This makes search authoritative across all pages with no backend change needed.
findings.backendTrace: Backend already supports it: /api/principals/ GET -> getSuperPrincipals reads req.query.q (3848) and req.query.status (3847) and applies them to the WHERE before pagination. The fix is frontend-only.

findings.title: must_change_password is updatable in the API but has no form field; new principals are not forced to rotate the shared default
findings.evidence: The SECTIONS form definition (SAStaffManager.js 64-119) has no must_change_password field, and ALL_FIELD_KEYS (line 121) therefore omits it, so the StaffForm never sends it. Yet the backend update whitelist includes 'must_change_password' (superadminDataController.js 3934) and create stores data.must_change_password (3909) - both always undefined from this UI. New principals are created with the well-known default password 'Principal@123' (3891) and there is no force-rotate flag set, so the flag stays whatever the DB default is.
findings.userImpact: Every principal created via this page who is given the auto default 'Principal@123' (when the admin leaves the password blank) keeps a guessable, shared default until they voluntarily change it, with no first-login rotation prompt enforced from this flow. Admins also cannot toggle the must_change_password requirement from the UI even though the field exists server-side.
findings.suggestedFix: Either set must_change_password: true automatically in createSuperPrincipal when the password falls back to the default, or add a checkbox to the Account section of StaffForm. Pair with a first-login password-change gate for the principal role so the shared default cannot persist.
findings.backendTrace: /api/principals/ POST -> createSuperPrincipal (3882) accepts must_change_password but the UI never sends it; the field plumbing exists, only the UI control and the auto-force-on-default are missing.

summary: The slice has TWO separate finance-staff managers, both reachable from the school-admin sidebar and backed by different tables. (1) The "bursar" page (SABursar -> SAStaffManager kind="bursar") is solid end-to-end: real CRUD against /api/bursars/ (CoreBursar table), tenant-scoped via scopedSchoolId/outsideScope, write-gated to school_admin+superadmin, one-time credentials modal works, responsive. (2) The "finance-users" page (FinanceUsersPage + FinanceUsers/* components) is a banking-grade-looking UI sitting on a thin backend that stores only role/access_level against the SchoolAdmin table. The page renders many real-looking analytics (transactions today, volume, risk levels, transaction heat, alerts, integrity hashing) that the backend never supplies, so they are permanently zero/fabricated. The Add form collects permissions, scope, transaction limit and working hours that createFinanceUser silently discards. "Edit Role" is a coming-soon banner with no implementation. The GET list endpoint is not role-gated, exposing finance-staff PII (emails/phones) to any authenticated tenant user. The two managers do not share data, which is confusing for an admin. The prior audit's "View crashes / panels fabricated" claim is partially fixed: the View modal now guards undefined fields (no crash), but the dashboards above the list are still fabricated/empty and the IntegrityPanel still makes hardcoded SHA-256/audit-trail claims. There are also two genuine frontend wiring bugs: TransactionHeat reads fields heatSummary never produces (blank icons/sub, undefined React keys), and FiltersBar's Activity and Risk filter groups are rendered-but-never-wired (page never passes those props, so they do nothing).
workingWell: SABursar (bursar nav page) is fully functional end-to-end: SAStaffManager issues real CRUD to /api/bursars/ (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE + PATCH toggle/block), all routes exist in superadmin.js (lines 309-314) and the controllers (createSuperBursar/updateSuperBursar/getSuperBursars in superadminDataController.js) perform real DB writes against CoreBursar + User.

Bursar tenant isolation is correct: getSuperBursars uses scopedSchoolId(req) and returns an empty list for an unscoped superadmin; createSuperBursar pins school_id from scope; updateSuperBursar rejects out-of-scope ids via outsideScope() -> 404. A school_admin only ever sees their own school's bursars (school_id from JWT).
The one-time credentials modal in SAStaffManager works: createSuperBursar returns {username, password} and handleSave surfaces them in a copyable modal (SAStaffManager.js lines 197-203, 349-365).
Both pages are mobile-responsive: FinanceUsers.css and SAStaffManager.css carry @media(max-width:600px) rules; the SAStaffManager table is wrapped in a scrollable .sasm-table-wrap.

FinanceUserDetails (the 'View' modal) no longer crashes on users lacking tx/perms/scope data — every optional section is guarded (Array.isArray / != null checks at lines 78, 96, 106, 119), fixing the prior audit's crash claim.

Finance-user write endpoints are role-gated: /api/school/finance-users/ POST and PUT pass through schoolWriteGuard (school.js lines 150-155) which enforces requireRole(['school_admin','superadmin']) on mutating methods, and createFinanceUser/updateFinanceUser pin school_id from getSchoolFromUser(req).

findings.title: Finance Users page shows fabricated/permanently-zero analytics the backend never supplies
findings.evidence: financeController.js getFinanceUsers (lines 677-687) returns ONLY {id, full_name, email, phone, username, is_active, role, access_level, created_at}. finance.utils.js summariseUsers (lines 24-41) derives txToday/volToday/volTotal/receipts/refunds/flagged/highVol/riskLevels from fields (u.tx_today, u.tx_amount, u.receipts_today, u.flagged, u.risk...) that are NEVER present in the response, so every aggregate is 0/empty. StatsCards.jsx renders 'Transactions Today' (value summary.txToday => 0) and 'Total Volume Today' (=> $0) as if real; ActivityPanel always shows Payments/Receipts/Refunds = 0; TransactionHeat always shows 0 tx; FuRiskPill falls back to FU_RISK.low so every user is labeled 'Low Risk' (FinanceUserCard.jsx line 74 via finance.utils).
findings.userImpact: A school admin sees an authoritative-looking finance operations dashboard (transactions today, volume, risk levels, transaction heat by time of day) that is permanently empty or a fixed fabrication. They may believe no money moved today, or trust a 'Low Risk' label that is just a default. This is misleading for a financial control surface.
findings.suggestedFix: Either remove the StatsCards tx/volume cards, ActivityPanel, TransactionHeat and risk pills until the backend computes them from real Payment/Receipt rows, or extend getFinanceUsers to join the finance tables and return per-user tx_today/tx_amount/tx_total/receipts_today/refunds_today/risk so the panels reflect reality. Do not present derived-from-nothing metrics as live data.
findings.backendTrace: GET /api/school/finance-users/ -> school.js:338 (applyAuth) -> financeController.getFinanceUsers (lines 666-694): selects SchoolAdmin rows for school.id and maps a minimal user shape; no transaction/risk data is queried or returned.

findings.title: Finance-users list endpoint is not role-gated — any authenticated tenant user can read finance staff PII
findings.evidence: applyAuth = [authenticateToken, requireActiveAccount, schoolScope, schoolWriteGuard] (school.js:159). schoolWriteGuard only enforces a role on MUTATING_METHODS (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) (school.js:149-155); GET requests fall straight through with no requireRole. GET /api/school/finance-users/ (school.js:338) therefore runs for ANY authenticated active user in the tenant. getFinanceUsers returns email + phone + username for each finance/bursar account (financeController.js:677-687).
findings.userImpact: A logged-in teacher, parent, or student in the same school can call GET /api/school/finance-users/ and retrieve the finance team's names, emails and phone numbers. It is scoped to their own school (no cross-tenant leak) but still over-discloses staff contact PII to non-admin roles.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a read role gate for sensitive admin listings, e.g. wrap finance-users GET with requireRole(['school_admin','superadmin']) (and similarly principal-users), rather than relying solely on schoolWriteGuard which ignores GET.
findings.backendTrace: GET /api/school/finance-users/ -> school.js:338 applyAuth -> schoolScope pins req.schoolId from JWT (correct, no cross-tenant) but no role check on GET -> getFinanceUsers returns staff PII.

findings.title: Add Finance User form collects permissions/scope/limit/working-hours that the backend silently discards
findings.evidence: AddFinanceUserForm.submit (lines 51-62) POSTs {permissions, scope, transaction_limit, working_hours, role, ...}. createFinanceUser (financeController.js:701) destructures only {full_name, email, phone, username, password, role, access_level} and creates SchoolAdmin with just {role, access_level, is_active} (lines 717-723). permissions, scope, transaction_limit, working_hours are never read or persisted. Also note the form sends first_name/last_name + email but createFinanceUser expects full_name (it splits full_name into first/last at lines 712-713) — the form never sends full_name, so first_name/last_name end up empty.
findings.userImpact: An admin carefully configures a Cashier's permissions, the classes they can collect from, a per-transaction limit and working hours, sees 'Finance user created successfully', but none of that is saved. Worse, because the form sends first_name/last_name (not full_name), the created user's name is blank in the DB and the list later shows the username only. The granular access control the UI advertises does nothing.
findings.suggestedFix: Align the contract: either persist permissions/scope/transaction_limit/working_hours on a finance-user model (new columns or a related table) and have createFinanceUser store them, or strip those fields from the form until supported. Fix the name mismatch — accept first_name/last_name in createFinanceUser (or have the form send full_name).
findings.backendTrace: POST /api/school/finance-users/ -> school.js:339 (applyAuth, write-gated) -> createFinanceUser (financeController.js:696-730): creates User + SchoolAdmin with role/access_level only; ignores permissions/scope/transaction_limit/working_hours; relies on full_name which the form does not send.

findings.title: 'Edit Role' action on every finance user is a dead 'coming soon' banner
findings.evidence: FinanceUsersPage.handleEdit (lines 77-78) only does setBanner({type:'ok', text: `Edit Role: open ...'s role editor (coming soon).`}). It is wired to the 'Edit Role' button on every card (FinanceUserCard.jsx lines 130-132) and in the details modal (FinanceUserDetails.jsx lines 139-141). No editor opens, no API is called.

findings.suggestedFix: Implement a role/permission edit modal that PUTs to /api/school/finance-users/:id/ (extend the controller to accept role/permission changes), or remove the Edit Role buttons until the editor exists so the UI doesn't advertise a non-feature.
findings.backendTrace: No endpoint is called. updateFinanceUser (financeController.js:732-747) ignores req.body entirely and only flips is_active, so even if Edit Role POSTed role changes the backend would not apply them.

findings.title: TransactionHeat renders blank icons/sublabels and uses undefined React keys (field-shape mismatch)
findings.evidence: heatSummary (finance.utils.js:45-57) returns objects shaped {label, count, pct, level} only. TransactionHeat.jsx maps them expecting h.key (line 25 key={h.key}), h.icon (line 28 ) and h.sub (line 30 {h.sub}) — none of which exist. It looks half-rendered. (It is also always all-zero because the underlying tx data is never supplied — see fu-fabricated-finance-dashboards.)
findings.suggestedFix: Merge FU_HEAT_BUCKETS into the heatSummary output (map by index to attach key/label/sub/icon) so TransactionHeat receives the fields it reads, and use h.key (or the bucket key) as the React key.
findings.backendTrace: N/A — pure frontend data-shape bug; no backend involved.

findings.title: Activity and Risk filter groups are rendered but never wired (no-op chips)
findings.evidence: FiltersBar renders four filter groups including 'Activity' (FU_ACTIVITY_OPTIONS) and 'Risk' (FU_RISK_OPTIONS) bound to props activityFilter/onActivity and riskFilter/onRisk (FiltersBar.jsx lines 56-57). FinanceUsersPage renders <FiltersBar> passing ONLY search/role/status props (FinanceUsersPage.jsx lines 134-138) — activityFilter, onActivity, riskFilter, onRisk are undefined. The page's visibleUsers filter (lines 80-90) only filters by role/status/search; activity and risk are never applied.

findings.suggestedFix: Either wire activity/risk filter state into FinanceUsersPage and apply it in visibleUsers, or remove the Activity and Risk groups from FiltersBar until the backend returns activity/risk fields to filter on.
